draft.subject: Following up on your note about Maple Systems
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for your note about timing — for reference, a cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing cycle, not immediately, and your recent ticket is now closed.

Since you still have time on the account, I'd like to make it count. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Maple Systems works.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first step with you.

Best,
Nadia
